items.content_html: Recipe Ideas is a lightweight web app built with pure React, CSS, and SCSS that helps users search for recipes and get cooking inspiration. Simply enter a query to find recipe ideas, explore different meal options, and filter out ingredients you want to avoid. It’s designed to be easy to use, and for anyone looking to plan their next meal.
